title: The API now has a map
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: clearer API docs, queryable usage data, and a development setup with fewer mysterious local incantations.

An OpenAPI specification gives builders a machine-readable reference for the platform API, making it easier to inspect endpoints, generate clients, and wire pollinations into things without archaeology.

A new Tinybird hourly_token_usage endpoint adds configurable usage queries, giving the system a clearer view of token activity over time.

The development shell was made reproducible and smoother to use, with sops-based secrets management included so local setup has fewer handwritten rituals.
